evidence.quote: Compared with the projections made in December, the median path is about ½ percentage point lower this year and next; the median longer-run normal federal funds rate has been revised down as well.
Such caution is appropriate given that short-term interest rates are still near zero, which means that monetary policy has greater scope to respond to upside than to downside changes in the outlook.
So I'm wary and haven't yet concluded that we have seen any significant uptick that will be lasting in, for example, in core inflation.
The labor market continues to strengthen.
Maintaining our sizable holdings of longer-term securities should help maintain accommodative financial conditions
April remains a live meeting, and we will be tracking incoming data.

Still-expected gradual hikes and a 'live' April meeting temper the dovish lean.
